title: VUA project-ops command v0.2
description: Project-domain write commands (proposal 014 arbitrated 2026-09-09; v0.2 adds project.setNote per the D-6 desktop confirmation, proposal 013 inline thread, core upgrade batch 2026-09-12). project.import-copy is the single write path VUA has toward ALCOM/VCC-managed original projects (product-boundary 1.2.0, user ruling U3) — it creates a NEW project directory as a VUA-managed copy and never touches the original. Two phases in one closed command: phase=plan computes the copy scope (per-entry disk estimate, excluded entries, target path) and a plan digest; phase=apply re-computes the plan, refuses on drift, copies with the exclusions, gives the new project its own identity, records the source link, and re-inspects. project.setNote sets (or clears, with null) the user note of one VUA-native project (user ruling 12: the note is displayed only in the project list; the D-6 ruling A adds the list inline-edit write path). The note attaches to the VUA-native declaration only — a project without a readable identity file is refused (guards project_not_found / not_vua_native / identity_unreadable, frozen in the v0.2 result schema); guards are server-side facts evaluated inside the task. projectPath is the same registered-path identity the proposal-013 read face uses (inspectProject/lockStatus); no separate project id exists in this word-list family. Single-line plain text: a note carries no line breaks; clearing uses null, not an empty string. Nine-state task semantics (commandId idempotency, no implicit resume) ride the application-contract task surface, not this schema; the note task is a short single-file rewrite and completes immediately after acceptance.

note.description: The user note (single-line plain text, ruling 12: list display only). null clears an existing note; an empty string is not a note and is refused.
